messages:
jordan: Postmortem follow-up for the latency spikes on inference-gpu last night. We need concrete runbook edits: a short 'first 5 minutes' triage checklist, exact commands to run, and a clear escalation path. Who can own?

priya: I can take ownership of the runbook edits (triage steps + commands). Aiming for Tue EOD. Will add a small TL;DR at top.

liam: Thanks Priya. FYI recurring pattern: most spikes align with model reload churn + KV cache evictions. Suggest adding a 'check reload rate' check and a safe restart step for worker pods.

liam: quick commands to include: 
```
# check pod restarts and logs
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide --sort-by=.status.startTime
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-worker -c runtime --tail=200

# check model reload metric (prom)
curl -sS http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=model_reload_count
```

eva: For escalation, please add an explicit severity routing table:
- Sev 1 (service degraded >30 min or 5%+ error): page oncall-sre -> escalate to eng-runtime lead -> notify infra PM
- Sev 2 (intermittent latency): message #eng-runtime + oncall, triage 15m window
Also add fallback policy: route traffic to model-quantized variant if throughput drops.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-23T03:14Z created: inference latency spike. PagerDuty trigger attached.

oncall-bot: Reminder: include the incident id in the runbook checklist when documenting.

priya: @eva I can add the severity matrix, can you confirm the exact escalation order and PD schedules?

eva: Confirmed. Escalation order: oncall-sre -> eng-runtime -> infra-eng lead. PD rotations and emails are in the ops handbook (I will link in PR). I'll own the escalation matrix section, target Wed EOD.

jordan: So owners: Priya = triage/checklist + commands; Liam = add cache/reload checks + safe restart notes; Eva = escalation matrix + fallback routing. Jordan = coordinate and add to action tracker. Deadlines: Priya Tue EOD, Eva Wed EOD, Liam Tue EOD.

liam: Quick note: include a line recommending increasing model cache TTL temporarily as a mitigation (if safe). Example PromQL to watch: `rate(model_reload_count[5m]) > 0.1`

priya: I'll open a PR in infra/runbooks and add a small 'playback' section: what to check in first 5m, 15m, 1h. Also will add the commands above and a sample evidence snippet to paste into postmortem.

jordan: Please also add a recurring action item: review this playbook monthly for any new patterns. Schedule ownership to oncall-rotation lead.

liam: PR opened: infra/runbooks#432 — adds commands, TTL suggestion, and KV cache checks. Please review.

priya: Reviewing now. Will link PR in the postmortem and add checklist items to the action tracker.

jordan: Great. After PRs merge let's run a short runbook runbook drill next week (15m) to verify steps are clear. :thumbsup:
